# Curated capabilities

For ordinary web UI work, including automatically selected requests such as "Review this checkout page", load bundled Impeccable with the request unchanged. Do not interpret natural-language task wording as a Design operation.

Use the table only when the user explicitly requests a Design operation with its command syntax. Match only the leading command of that operation, case-insensitively, followed by whitespace or the end of the request. A word inside a design task never selects a command. An explicit Design invocation alone does not turn an ordinary UI request into an operation.

| Leading command | Capability | Skill |
|---|---|---|
| `setup` | design-core:project-integration - Project setup and diagnostics | design |
| `status` | design-core:project-integration - Project setup and diagnostics | design |
| `diagnose` | design-core:project-integration - Project setup and diagnostics | design |
| `detect` | design-core:detector-scan - Explicit local detector scan | design |
| `questionnaire` | design-core:stakeholder-questionnaire - Stakeholder decision questionnaire | design |
| `review` | design-core:change-interface-review - Change-scoped interface review | design |

For every other request, including a leading `doctor`, load the bundled impeccable skill with the request unchanged (impeccable:general-web-design).

Follow the selected capability. A request explicitly addressed to Impeccable bypasses Design.
